restaurant_booking_setup.mapping: Easy!Appointments service records define table party-size ranges and providers define tables. Configure this synthetic restaurant dataset before enabling restaurant bookings.
restaurant_booking_setup.id_scope: Illustrative IDs only. The restaurant slot catalogue must be configured and resolved with get_slot_catalogue before use.

entries.question_et: Kas Meretuule Köök on päris restoran?
entries.answer_et: Ei. Meretuule Köök on väljamõeldud restoranidemo. Broneeringud ei anna õigust päris teenusele.
entries.question_en: Is Meretuule Kitchen a real restaurant?
entries.answer_en: No. Meretuule Kitchen is a fictional restaurant demo. Test bookings do not entitle you to a real service.
entries.answer_ru: Нет. Meretuule Köök — вымышленная демонстрация ресторана. Тестовое бронирование не даёт права на настоящую услугу.

entries.question_et: Kas saan laua siin päriselt broneerida?
entries.answer_et: Ei. See demo ei saada päris broneeringuid. Restoranilaudade taustsüsteem tuleb enne kasutust eraldi seadistada.
entries.question_en: Can I make a real table reservation here?
entries.answer_en: No. This demo does not send real reservations. A restaurant table backend must be configured before use.
entries.answer_ru: Нет. Эта демонстрация не создаёт настоящие бронирования. Систему бронирования ресторана нужно настроить отдельно.

entries.answer_et: Demol ei ole päris aadressi ega külastuskohta.
entries.answer_en: The demo has no real address or visitor location.
entries.answer_ru: У этой демонстрации нет настоящего адреса или места для посещения.

entries.question_en: Do I need to pay anything?
entries.answer_en: This demo does not collect payments. It cannot provide a quote for a real service.
entries.answer_ru: Эта демонстрация не принимает оплату и не подтверждает расценки настоящих услуг.
